product_metadata.title: Allewie King Size Platform Bed Frame with 4 Storage Drawers & Adjustable Headboard, Upholstered Square Stitched Button Tufted Design, No Box Spring Needed, Light Grey
features: Comes in 1 Box: This storage bed frame comes only in 1 box. With detailed instruction, assembly tools, and numbered parts, the assembly can be done within one hour.
Lavish & Modern: Upholstered in linen fabric with a button-tufted and square-stitched surface, this deluxe platform bed will add sophisticated style to any bedroom.
Space-saving Functionality: With four steel drawers underneath, it offers perfect storage space for bed sheets, accessories, off-season clothing, etc.
Adjustable Headboard: The headboard can be adjusted to 38 or 40.2 inches high so as to adjust for a 6-12 inches mattress.
Sturdy Structure: Strong wooden slats system does not require a box spring or any other additional foundations.
